questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows that the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: You are getting close to a railroad crossing. Look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Do not cross until all trains have passed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: The road ahead becomes slippery when it is wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This advisory speed sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An intersection is coming up. Watch for other vehicles crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot make a U-turn here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross safely. Be alert at intersections and when turning, as children may be crossing the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to possible hazards ahead. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet because it can be slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road ahead will curve to the right first, then to the left. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit depending on weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and keep more distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk where people cross the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic will soon merge from the right. Be ready to make room for these vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road intersects ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign warns you that wet roads are slippery and harder to control. Drive with extra caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill slope is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be prepared to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to an upcoming winding road with multiple curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply in the direction shown. Slow down as if you were making a turn at an intersection.
